title: values/apps.yaml
description: The hosted apps an env runs, one entry each, keyed by the app's folder name in the apps repository. Listing an app turns it on and grants it nothing; it needs the app-hosting feature. jarvis validate also checks each app at its pinned tag against core's app rules, and each grant against the app list.

propertyNames.description: A DNS label of at most 59 characters, so app-<name> fits one.

version.description: The app's release: v<x.y.z>, the apps repository's tag <app>/v<x.y.z>. The env runs that tag until this moves.

grants.description: What the env allows the app, one item per line, each taking effect only where the app file asks for the same item: privileged, root, host-network, host-path, hostname <name>, lan-port <port>/<TCP|UDP>, lan-all, lan-target <name> <cidr> <port>/<TCP|UDP>.

backups.description: Whether the app's backup: true volumes are backed up. On, jarvis secrets mints the app's own credential and validate requires it, once the app keeps such a volume. Off, none is sealed and nothing reports the volumes.

values.description: Values for the app's chart, laid over the app file's own; only for an app whose file names a chart. jarvis validate renders the chart with them against core's app rules.
